row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence Filed under TPU-LW on 2026-09-28 (m223-what-the-makers-say-it-is), moved from TPU, hardness not stated: foaming TPU, "Actively Foaming Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU)" (D-SIRAYA-siraya-tech-flex-tpu-air-tds, p. 1). Its own page says it is an actively foaming TPU, "Up to 50% lighter than standard TPUs", printing between 63A and 78A: a foaming TPU is TPU-LW, filed by its foaming and not its hardness (as a conductive TPU is by its load, R204). Read by an AI agent (claude-opus-5.5), not a person.
